items.title: Restoring reliability to an insurance quote API
items.takeaway: After the fix, two load tests recorded zero failures across 138,553 quote requests.
items.diagnosis: In the initial load test, 57.7% of quote requests failed and p95 latency reached 71 seconds. I helped trace the issue to a synchronous call cycle. Quote requests held the available Tomcat threads while waiting for the rating service, whose callbacks needed those same threads.
items.approach: Passing the calculation data directly broke the cycle and preserved the rating inputs and logic. A check after that change recorded no timeouts. Quotes still took about 22 seconds, and logs pointed to repeated remote feature flag lookups. The follow-up changes cached flag configuration, removed redundant flag checks, added a MongoDB index for a lookup that scanned the collection, and logged timings for each stage.

results.caption: Load test results by run
results.note: The two retests ran at different throughputs. The baseline figures cover error rate and p95 only.

items.title: Isolating Kubernetes health probes from application traffic
items.takeaway: A UAT load test recorded eight JVM restarts across two pods in roughly 21 minutes.
items.diagnosis: I investigated the restarts and traced them to the shared backend deployment chart. All three probes ran on the application port. When incoming traffic exhausted Tomcat’s request threads, liveness checks timed out and Kubernetes restarted containers that were still processing requests.
items.approach: The fix moved startup, readiness, and liveness probes to a dedicated Spring Boot Actuator management port in the shared chart. The probes now use a separate request pool within the same JVM. The gateway health route and deployment automation were updated to use the management port.

items.title: Building an AI development kit for engineering teams
items.takeaway: I co-developed an internal Claude Code plugin that standardizes how engineers use AI agents to plan, implement, and review changes for an insurance platform.
items.diagnosis: I designed and built an Argo CD log triage skill that turns the first pass of an incident investigation into a single prompt. It fetches Kubernetes pod logs, verifies that they cover the requested time window, and separates infrastructure noise from application errors. Before rollout, I fixed how the skill handled UTC offsets and resolved pod identities.
items.approach: I also adapted the develop skill to apply our team’s coding standards during implementation. Engineers used it in a planning, implementation, and review workflow with human approval before write actions. I helped remove plaintext database credentials from shell profiles during onboarding.
